# Lunar imagery attribution

- `moon-color.jpg`: converted from the 4096 x 2048 TIFF at https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004700/a004720/lroc_color_poles_4k.tif . Source: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/ . Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, Ernie Wright; LROC/LOLA instrument teams. This is the 2019 visualization mosaic, not a landing-scale scientific product.
- `moon-height.jpg`: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004700/a004720/ldem_3_8bit.jpg . Same NASA SVS source; LOLA height preview. Used for subtle bump shading only, not for measurement.
- `tycho-detail.png`: https://lroc.sese.asu.edu/news/uploads/wac_tycho_highphase.png . NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University. North-up LROC WAC mosaic, approximately 130 km wide. Related file metadata: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LRO_WAC_Tycho_crater_mosaic.jpg . Draped approximately for visual context, not orthorectified landing coordinates. Original baked lighting is preserved.

All zone inputs, suitability criteria, terrain profiles and candidate positions are synthetic. Image content is never used to infer or validate these measurements.
